policy.pricing_basis: Prices are US dollars for personal plans, as shown on each provider's official page. Monthly price is the price when billed monthly. Annual price is the total for one year when billed yearly. Prices exclude sales tax.
policy.promotion_policy: First-year, sale and lifetime prices are not used as standard prices. They are noted separately.
policy.storage_units: Cost per TB uses 1 TB = 1,000 GB, as providers advertise.
policy.excluded_providers: MEGA could not be checked from an official source and Carbonite lists only business plans, so neither is included.
policy.affiliate_policy: No affiliate links are used on this comparison.
